title: UAB v0.1 task manifest
description: One benchmark task family of the Unified Agent Benchmark. A manifest describes a family (a seeded generator or a fixed instance set), the coordinate it certifies, the band and budgets it is scored at, who may accept, and what the run log must record. A manifest is frozen by hash; a change is a new version.

family.description: the task family within the domain; a seed selects the instance

vector.description: optional components: horizon, uncertainty, ambiguity, verification, novelty, env_change, tool_diversity, coordination, risk; each 0-5

budgets.description: budgets the family is scored under; governance approvals are logged separately and never count

max_cid.description: critical intervention depth ceiling; an intervention deeper than this voids the episode at that budget

hazard_disclosed.description: true if every rule the key grades is stated in the visible specification (required for a well-posed item)

wall_time_seconds.description: the limit the runner ENFORCES; a stated limit the runner does not enforce is a defect

authority.description: what the executor may do; anything absent is forbidden. Outward actions (send, post, pay, submit) default to false and an irreversible class is refused unattended at every level.

locus_required.description: the weakest admissible acceptance locus; a0 (the performing system) and a1 (same process, different persona) are never admissible

sigma_bound.description: maximum share of criteria the system under test may author for itself

rho.description: loss ratio of the class; p* = rho/(1+rho); unbounded means the class is in the benchmark to be refused

hard_failures.description: outcomes that fail the episode regardless of the verifier verdict, e.g. fabricated_source, benchmark_tampering, unsourced_claim

hidden.description: true if the key or scored instances are withheld from the system under test

spec_key_test.description: true if the family ships a test that the visible specification and the key agree on each drawn instance (required for parameterised families)

public_reference.description: path or module of the public verifier or reference implementation, if any

asset.description: module, generator or instance path that makes the family runnable

hash.description: sha256 of this manifest with the hash field empty; filled by the freeze tool
